messages:
oncall-bot: Paging maya: high enqueue latency detected in runtime-pool-us-east. median_enqueue_ms=610 (+200% vs baseline), inflight_queue_depth=342, 5xx_rate=1.8%. Alert: autoshed=false.
maya: seeing spikes on grafana too. CDT shows a queue tail growing since 03:12 UTC.
liam: which routes? any customer errors?
maya: mostly /v1/generate for small-batch chat flows. A few customer 503s in the last 5m (trace ids attached). customer impact: degraded latency for a subset of multitenant hosts, one partner reported timeouts.
sara: quick mitigations we should consider: 1) lower max_inflight on runtime-pool-us-east 2) enable route-level rate limiting for non-prod and low-tier 3) raise request timeout to avoid cascading retries 4) temporarily disable long-running batch pipelines. prefer atomic changes.
kevin: I can run the control-plane changes. recommend change set: set_max_inflight(pool=runtime-pool-us-east, value=40) && set_route_rate_limit(prefix=/v1/generate, tier=free, rps=10) && set_global_request_timeout(60s).
maya: agree. Order: max_inflight -> route limits -> timeout. We want to shed backlog quickly. Also add an inbound prefix cache bypass for abacus-partner? they reported failures.
liam: add CS notify: notify abacus-partner and the top 3 affected customers that we've initiated mitigation and will update with ETA. support-bot, please open an interim incident note.
support-bot: Created incident INC-2026-3099. Notified abacus-partner (ticket #A-412).
kevin: running command now:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/runtime/actions" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"action":"set_max_inflight","pool":"runtime-pool-us-east","value":40}'
```
kevin: response: {"status":"ok","prev_value":80,"new_value":40}
sara: good. monitor queue depth for 2m. If not improving, we rollback or reduce further to 25.
maya: queue depth dropping: 342 -> 180 -> 95 in 3 cycles. enqueue_ms trending down to 220ms.
liam: start applying route-level rate limits for free tier now. kevin?
kevin: applying rate limit:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/traffic/rate_limit" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"/v1/generate","tier":"free","rps":10}'
```
kevin: applied. support-bot: log change to INC-2026-3099.
support-bot: Logged mitigation step: lowered max_inflight and applied tiered rate limits.
maya: we still see a handful of 503s for abacus-partner. their requests are hitting a different pool because they use pinned hosts. Can we burst them to dedicated capacity?
sara: option: temporarily bump their quota via admin API to route to dedicated pool or route them to runtime-pool-us-east-dedicated if available. That takes 1-2 min to propagate.
kevin: I can run a temporary pin:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/customers/abacus/route" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"target":"runtime-pool-us-east-dedicated","ttl":3600}'
```
kevin: pin applied. abacus requests now routed. they reported success in 45s.
maya: nice. keep monitoring. I'm going to start a handoff note for the next oncall. eve, you'll be on in ~30m, FYI.
eve: taking notes. summary?
liam: summary for handoff: incident INC-2026-3099. Symptoms: elevated enqueue latency and queue depth in runtime-pool-us-east causing user 503s. Actions taken: reduced max_inflight 80->40, applied free-tier rps limit on /v1/generate, temporarily pinned abacus to dedicated pool, increased request timeout to 60s. Current status: enqueue_ms ~180ms, inflight_queue_depth ~70, 5xx_rate down to 0.3%.
eve: thanks. what's the rollback plan?
sara: rollback plan: if metrics hold for 15m, revert magic changes gradually: remove pin for abacus, restore route limits (or keep if beneficial), increase max_inflight back to baseline during low traffic window with staged step 40->60->80. If metrics regress at any step, revert to previous stable value and inform CS.
maya: CS should send a short note to affected customers now that mitigation is in place and we expect continued monitoring. kevin please run a quick smoke test across regions.
kevin: smoke test: all primary routes in us-east ok, us-west unaffected.
support-bot: Sent update to abacus-partner, created follow-up ticket for engineering postmortem.
liam: any flags for oncall runbook? timeouts increased to 60s (was 30s) — watch for retry storms. We should also keep an eye on token cache hit ratio, some retries were due to expired kv caches.
eve: I'll own next 2 hours and escalate if metrics go up. will create a short postmortem draft after stable.
maya: thanks all. final note: create a regression test in perf-runner to emulate the /v1/generate small-batch spike so we can tune max_inflight for realistic workloads.
kevin: recorded runbook steps in the incident doc.
maya: incident moved to monitoring state. closing the page. :white_check_mark:
